description: Phase 1: Admin User Search - Fix backend search to include fullName field, and fix frontend to debounce search input and cancel stale requests
steps: 1. In backend/src/modules/admin/admin.service.js, in the getUsers function, add { fullName: { $regex: safeSearch, $options: 'i' } } to the existing $or filter array (currently only has username and email).

2. In admin/src/pages/Users.tsx, the search input fires fetchUsers on every keystroke via the useEffect that depends on searchQuery. Add debouncing: import useCallback or a debounce pattern, and implement a 300ms debounce on the search effect. Use a useRef-based approach with setTimeout/clearTimeout since we cannot install lodash.

3. In admin/src/pages/Users.tsx, implement request cancellation using AbortController. Create an AbortController ref, abort the previous request before starting a new one, and pass the signal to the api.get call. This prevents stale responses from overwriting newer results.
4. Update the search input placeholder from 'Search by username or email...' to 'Search by name, username, or email...' to reflect the new fullName search capability.
acceptance_criteria: Backend getUsers $or filter includes fullName regex in addition to username and email
Frontend search input is debounced (300ms delay before firing API call)
Previous in-flight search requests are cancelled when a new search is initiated
Search placeholder text reflects the new search capability
All existing search functionality (username, email) still works
Pagination still resets to page 1 on new search
verification: Read admin.service.js and confirm $or array has 3 entries: username, email, fullName
Read Users.tsx and confirm debounce logic with setTimeout/clearTimeout pattern exists
Read Users.tsx and confirm AbortController is used with api.get signal option
findings: All changes implemented successfully. Backend $or filter now has 3 entries (username, email, fullName). Frontend uses useRef-based debounce (300ms) with setTimeout/clearTimeout and AbortController for request cancellation. Axios CanceledError is caught to avoid setting error state on aborted requests. node -c validates backend JS syntax. TSX brace/paren/bracket balance confirmed. Committed as ab80767.
